selected_addon_asset_path.pack_storage_relationship: NTFS hardlink to the Rust bundle pack; both servers share one physical pack allocation.
selected_addon_asset_path.lookup: Retained immutable SQLite selects and orders candidate row IDs; a bounded row/response LRU caches repeats.
selected_addon_asset_path.audio_resolution: Each row ID resolves in O(1) through a fixed 16-byte mmap record into a lazily mapped pack slice.
selected_addon_asset_path.activation: --lookup-mode sqlite automatically opens user_files/fast_audio/active.json when the compiled pack is present.
selected_addon_asset_path.notes: The 9.45 MB row-ID index and 1.71 GB pack are memory-mapped lazily; pack size is virtual address space, not startup working-set residency.

addon_verification.coverage: Legacy and packed play/cache behavior, full/open/suffix/ranged-HEAD HTTP semantics, clean 304, OPTIONS conditional headers, malformed overlay handling, pack lease/reload lifetime, DB publish/cache epoch ordering, atomic memory publication, reload during serialization, blocked audio writers, historical immutable URLs across reload/restart, direct-play selection swaps, corruption rejection, and resource closure.
addon_verification.notes: The reviewer deterministically reproduced the pre-fix stale-cache publication race before validating the epoch/lease fix; this is regression evidence, not merely a code inspection.

matrices.name: every distinct non-null exact expression/reading key
comprehensive Forvo filters across all five speakers

native_component.notes: Native lookup timings include filter/order/URL/JSON work and bypass response caching. Sorted, MPH, and preload serialized bodies were byte-identical. A separate 2,048-query differential check found exact ordered (name, source, speaker, reading) tuple parity against SQLite; its whole-body checksum differed as expected because it serialized legacy row-ID URLs instead of bundle-audio-ID URLs. Native audio timings create the exact zero-copy Bytes owner used by HTTP and touch/hash the warm sampled payload; this is broader work than the add-on's 1.2 us pack-slice-view-only microbenchmark and the two figures are not directly comparable. End-to-end HTTP is measured independently.

native_http_architecture.qualification: Performance matrix predates only the additive /v1/candidates reading-field rebuild; lookup, audio, index, and transport code are unchanged in the final executable.
native_http_architecture.selection_rationale: MPH+pack gives the best balanced desktop result: median 32-worker throughput was 22.2% above sorted+pack and 19.1% above preload; packed-audio latency was 42.8% lower than individual files, while avoiding preload's roughly 28.3 MiB extra startup working set and 1.94x startup median.

native_bundle_compile.notes: Compiler exact-byte collision checks found no content-identical data at distinct source paths. Mapping aliases remain as postings while paths map to packed offsets.
